tools.name: score_cv
tools.description: Assess the supplied CV only (assessmentKind=source_only), without generating a document or predicted after score. With v2b, method=offer-phrase-coverage-v1 measures exact positive coverage of frozen phrases copied from offer requirements and duties, with phrase counts and matched/missing lists; an empty inventory scores zero. phraseCount (not requirementCount) is the denominator; the inventory is extracted once per exact offer text and reused (assessment.inventoryHash); nested phrases count once. Other engines retain method=jev-probability-v1 with semantic per-requirement probabilities. Neither is an employer ATS score or hiring probability. Use tailor_cv for actual before/after documents.

cvText.description: Relevant CV or resume text, at least 80 characters after trimming. Omit contact details and sensitive identifiers.

jobDescription.description: The job posting as plain text, at least 80 characters after trimming. The CV and job posting together must fit in 20000 UTF-8 bytes when encoded as JSON, including JSON syntax and escapes.

tools.name: tailor_cv
tools.description: Tailor a supplied CV/resume to a specific job posting. A successful tailoring returns the actual tailored CV and before/after assessments, plus role-fit notes, interview preparation and a cover letter when available. A role mismatch or a finding of possible added or omitted facts can prevent delivery of a tailored CV. AI can make mistakes; review every change. Text input/output only; does not access saved accounts, export PDFs or submit applications. Limited to 2 calls per day per network.
